participation.context: Walked through the stiffness, and left the gleaners to the field.

participation.context: Refused the spare, and kept the pace.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

relations.note: the last day, still on foot
relations.quote: You will not be offered the spare for a stiffness you can still walk on.

story.body: You named the stiff morning and kept your feet. The field did not look up, and you left it to its own work.

participation.context: Named the city, and what it wants.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

relations.quote: There she is. Dear, dirty, and wants everything by Thursday.

story.body: The carriers' road came over a rise and London lay under its smoke. Hobbins greeted it. You walked on.

relations.quote: There she is. Dear, dirty, and wants everything by Thursday.

title: Saw London's smoke from the rise

story.body: You let Gilbert have the three sentences and the gloves. You paid Hobbins what the kitchen had deferred. You heard the baker's name, and you left the debt where it was. You slept at the Bell.
